name: jenkins-lighthouse
description: Safely upgrade legacy Jenkins (2.2xx-2.4xx on Java 8/11) to the current LTS (2.580.x, Java 21/25) with near-zero downtime, and batch-upgrade nginx fleets for high-severity CVEs (1.30.7 / 1.31.9) across containers, rpm, source builds, OpenResty and private-registry frontends — gated, verifiable, rollbackable.
